Practice

Mock exams

Five different timed practice papers of 40 questions each, written by Intellica from the public curriculum topics. They are practice, not real exam questions, and they do not predict your result.

Choose a paper

Exam mode is timed, shows no hints, and gives feedback only after you submit. Practice mode shows the explanation after each answer. Choose how long you have; the external exam is commonly described as about 75 minutes, so check the current rules with your certification body.

    Your readiness

    Practice-ready is Intellica guidance: at least 80 percent on each of three different mocks, and no chapter below 70 percent in any of them. It is not an iSAQB requirement and it does not guarantee a pass. Results are saved on this device only.
